core.title: Daisy Cabinet Door Pull, RK International CP-83

text.description_html:
RK International CP-83, 3" Daisy Cabinet Pull

This cheery cabinet pull is sure to brighten up any home. It has 3 inch center to centers and an overall length of 4 inches. The Daisy Cabinet Door Pull is designed with an attention to harmony. Every petal of the flower in the center seems to flow into the next as does the wave-like design that makes up the rest of the handle. It is available in oil rubbed bronze, polished brass, and satin nickel finishes.

Also Available Matching CK-183 Daisy Cabinet Knob and BP-383 Daisy Cabinet Pull Backplate

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-83 Flower Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/4"
  • Width: 15/16"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
